title: Cardiac Rehabilitation — Exercising Safely After a Heart Event

hook.en: After a heart attack or bypass, patients fear exercise. Yet supervised, graded exercise lowers deaths and readmissions. Learn the phases, how hard to push and when to stop.
hook.ur: Dil ke daure ya bypass ke baad mareez exercise se darte hain. Phir bhi nigrani wali, darje war exercise mauton aur dobara daakhilon ko kam karti hai. Marahil, kitna zor lagana hai aur kab rukna hai seekhein.

goal.en: By the end, you'll describe the phases of cardiac rehabilitation, screen before exercise, set intensity with heart rate and the Borg scale, and recognise stop signs and emergencies.
goal.ur: End tak aap cardiac rehabilitation ke marahil bayan karenge, exercise se pehle screening karenge, heart rate aur Borg scale se shiddat tay karenge, aur rukne ki nishaniyan aur emergencies pehchanenge.

text.en: **Cardiac rehabilitation** is a programme of exercise, education and risk-factor control for people with heart disease, after a heart attack, bypass surgery, stent or heart failure. It improves fitness, lowers the risk of another event and reduces hospital stays. It has **phases**: early mobilisation in hospital, a supervised outpatient programme, and long-term maintenance. Exercise is **graded** and **monitored**.
text.ur: **Cardiac rehabilitation** dil ke mareezon ke liye exercise, taleem aur khatre ke asbaab par qaboo ka programme hai, dil ke daure, bypass surgery, stent ya heart failure ke baad. Yeh fitness behtar karta hai, dobara daure ka khatra kam karta hai aur hospital ke din kam karta hai. Is ke **marahil** hain: hospital mein jaldi harkat, nigrani wala outpatient programme, aur taweel muddat ki maintenance. Exercise **darje war** aur **monitored** hoti hai.

text.en: Think of the heart as an **engine that has been repaired**. You do not take it straight on a motorway; you test it at low speed, listen for noises and raise the speed in steps. The "listening" is heart rate, blood pressure, symptoms and effort scores. Over weeks the engine runs smoother at higher loads.
text.ur: Dil ko **marammat shuda engine** samjhein. Aap isay seedha motorway par nahi le jate; kam raftar par test karte hain, awaazein sunte hain aur raftar qadam qadam barhate hain. "Sunna" yani heart rate, blood pressure, alamaat aur effort scores. Haftoon mein engine zyada load par zyada hamwar chalta hai.

steps.title: Screen before you start
steps.detail: Check resting heart rate, blood pressure, symptoms (chest pain, breathlessness, dizziness), the medicines taken and any changes since the last visit. Do not exercise if a stop criterion is present. || Shuru karne se pehle screening karein

steps.title: Warm up and set the effort
steps.detail: Warm up for five to ten minutes. Aim for an effort of about 11 to 14 on the Borg 6 to 20 scale ("fairly light" to "somewhat hard"), where the person can still talk. Use the prescribed heart rate range if there is one, as beta-blockers lower heart rate. || Warm up karein aur effort tay karein

steps.title: Monitor during exercise
steps.detail: Watch symptoms, colour, breathing and effort. Check blood pressure and heart rate during and after exercise. Keep the person within the planned effort and progress slowly. || Exercise ke dauran monitor karein

steps.title: Cool down, teach and review
steps.detail: Cool down for five to ten minutes, then teach the person warning signs, medicine use, home exercise and risk factors. Review progress and symptoms each session. || Cool down, sikhayein aur review karein

question.en: What effort level on the Borg 6 to 20 scale is usual for cardiac rehabilitation?
question.ur: Cardiac rehabilitation ke liye Borg 6 se 20 scale par aam effort kya hai?

feedback.en: That is too high for rehabilitation.
feedback.ur: Rehabilitation ke liye yeh bohat zyada hai.

feedback.en: That is too low to train.
feedback.ur: Training ke liye yeh bohat kam hai.

text.en: About 11 to 14, fairly light to somewhat hard
text.ur: Takreeban 11 se 14, khasa halka se kuch sakht

feedback.en: Yes — moderate effort with the ability to talk.
feedback.ur: Haan — darmiyana effort jis mein bolna mumkin ho.

rows.en: Sit, stand, walk and be confident before going home
rows.ur: Baithna, khara hona, chalna aur ghar jane se pehle aitemad

rows.en: Build fitness, control risk factors and keep going for life
rows.ur: Fitness banana, khatre ke asbaab par qaboo aur zindagi bhar jaari rakhna

rows.en: Walking, cycling, resistance training, group classes
rows.ur: Chalna, cycling, resistance training, group classes

rows.en: Close, with heart rate and blood pressure
rows.ur: Qareebi, heart rate aur blood pressure ke saath

rows.en: Supervised, then self-monitoring with a plan
rows.ur: Nigrani, phir plan ke saath khud nigrani
Kam blood pressure, chakkar, dil ki be-qaidagi

text.en: **Talk while you walk.** If the person can talk in sentences but not sing, the effort is about right. Stop for chest pain, severe breathlessness, dizziness or a very fast, irregular pulse.
text.ur: **Chalte hue bolein.** Agar shakhs jumlay bol sake magar gaa na sake to effort takreeban theek hai. Seene ke dard, shadeed saans ki tangi, chakkar ya bohat tez, be-qaida nabz par rukein.

text.en: **Using a target heart rate for everyone.** Medicines such as beta-blockers keep the heart rate low, so a formula may push someone too hard. Use the Borg scale and symptoms as well, and the range given by the cardiac team.
text.ur: **Har ek ke liye target heart rate.** Beta-blockers jaisi dawaiyan heart rate kam rakhti hain, is liye formula kisi ko zyada dhakel sakta hai. Borg scale aur alamaat bhi istemal karein, aur cardiac team ki di hui range.

question.en: Which finding means stop the exercise session?
question.ur: Kaun si finding exercise session rokne ka kehti hai?

text.en: Chest pain, severe breathlessness, dizziness or a fall in blood pressure
text.ur: Seene ka dard, shadeed saans ki tangi, chakkar ya blood pressure mein kami

feedback.en: Yes — sit the person down, check vital signs and seek help if it persists.
feedback.ur: Haan — shakhs ko bithayein, vital signs check karein aur jaari rahe to madad bulayein.

text.en: A heart rate rise within the planned range
text.ur: Tay shuda range ke andar heart rate ka izafa

question.en: After bypass surgery through the breastbone, which advice is usual?
question.ur: Seene ki haddi se bypass surgery ke baad kaun sa mashwara aam hai?

feedback.ur: Chalne ki hausla afzai ki jati hai.

text.en: Avoid heavy lifting and pushing with the arms for the first weeks, as the surgeon advises
text.ur: Pehle haftay surgeon ke mashware ke mutabiq bhari uthane aur bazuon se dhakelne se bachein

feedback.ur: Haan — shifa pa rahi seene ki haddi ko bachayein.
Yeh seene ki haddi par zor daalta hai.

text.en: **Build confidence as well as fitness.** Many patients are afraid, and families may stop them from doing anything. Explain the benefits, show them what a safe session feels like, and agree a simple home plan. Group classes help people to keep going.
text.ur: **Fitness ke saath aitemad bhi banayein.** Bohat se mareez dare hote hain, aur ghar walay unhein kuch karne se rok dete hain. Faide samjhayein, mehfooz session ka ehsaas dikhayein aur saada ghar ka plan tay karein. Group classes logon ko jaari rakhne mein madad deti hain.

question.en: Why can a "target heart rate" be misleading after a heart event?
question.ur: Dil ke waqiye ke baad "target heart rate" gumrah kyun kar sakta hai?

answer.en: Medicines, such as beta-blockers, lower the heart rate response to exercise, and the ability to exercise differs between people. A formula could ask someone to work too hard or too little. The Borg effort scale, the ability to talk, symptoms and the range given by the cardiac team are safer guides.
answer.ur: Dawaiyan, maslan beta-blockers, exercise par heart rate ka jawab kam karti hain, aur logon ki exercise ki salahiyat mukhtalif hoti hai. Ek formula kisi se zyada ya kam kaam maang sakta hai. Borg effort scale, bolne ki salahiyat, alamaat aur cardiac team ki di hui range zyada mehfooz rehnumai hain.

beats.patient: A 58-year-old man is three weeks after a heart attack with a stent, taking a beta-blocker. His resting heart rate is 58 and blood pressure 120 over 76. He wants to begin the outpatient programme but is afraid of chest pain.
beats.assessment: He has no stop criteria; the beta-blocker limits his heart rate, so effort scales are important, and fear needs addressing.
beats.treatment: Warm up, walk or cycle at an effort of 11 to 13, monitor symptoms and blood pressure, teach warning signs and agree a progression.
beats.reassess: After eight weeks he walks 30 minutes at a fairly brisk pace and feels confident.

text.en: **Call emergency help** for chest pain that does not settle with rest, severe breathlessness, fainting, a very fast or irregular pulse with symptoms, or a blood pressure fall with grey, sweaty skin. Do not exercise a person with unstable angina, uncontrolled arrhythmia, a resting heart rate or blood pressure outside the programme limits, or a new illness with fever.
text.ur: **Emergency madad bulayein** seene ka dard jo aaram se na thame, shadeed saans ki tangi, behoshi, alamaat ke saath bohat tez ya be-qaida nabz, ya blood pressure ka girna sard, paseene mein dooba jild ke saath. Unstable angina, be-qaboo dil ki be-qaidagi, programme ki hadood se bahar aaram ka heart rate ya blood pressure, ya bukhar ke saath nayi bimari mein exercise na karwayein.

summary.en: Cardiac rehabilitation combines exercise, education and risk-factor control, in early, outpatient and maintenance phases.
summary.ur: Cardiac rehabilitation exercise, taleem aur khatre ke asbaab par qaboo ko milata hai, shuruati, outpatient aur maintenance marahil mein.

summary.en: Screen before each session and keep effort at about 11 to 14 on the Borg scale, using symptoms and the cardiac team's range rather than a formula.
summary.ur: Har session se pehle screening karein aur effort Borg scale par takreeban 11 se 14 rakhein, formula ke bajaye alamaat aur cardiac team ki range istemal karte hue.

summary.en: Know the stop signs and emergencies, and build the patient's confidence as well as fitness.
summary.ur: Rukne ki nishaniyan aur emergencies jaanein, aur mareez ki fitness ke saath aitemad bhi banayein.

front.en: Name the three phases of cardiac rehabilitation.
front.ur: Cardiac rehabilitation ke teen marahil batayein.

back.en: Early (hospital), supervised outpatient and long-term maintenance.
back.ur: Shuruati (hospital), nigrani wala outpatient aur taweel muddat ki maintenance.

front.en: What Borg effort level is usual?

back.en: About 11 to 14 on the 6 to 20 scale.

front.en: Why is a formula heart rate unreliable?
front.ur: Formula heart rate bharosemand kyun nahi?

back.en: Medicines such as beta-blockers change the heart rate response.
back.ur: Beta-blockers jaisi dawaiyan heart rate ka jawab badal deti hain.

front.en: Name two reasons to stop a session.
front.ur: Session rokne ki do wajuhat batayein.

back.en: Chest pain, severe breathlessness, dizziness or a fall in blood pressure.
back.ur: Seene ka dard, shadeed saans ki tangi, chakkar ya blood pressure mein kami.

note.en: Measure heart rate, blood pressure and effort.
note.ur: Heart rate, blood pressure aur effort naapein.
Chalne ki salahiyat mehfooz tareeqe se naapein.
